round: Original character casting · narrator and original voices
note: Three options per character. Qwen Base does not support delivery instructions; narrator variations were omitted. B/C are existing presets, not newly designed voices. Selected Chapter 6 excerpts, with identical narration between turns. Unfamiliar-line files and retry records retained locally.

voices.name: Candidate A
voices.description: Julian Vale · unchanged Qwen Base narrator reference and production settings. No delivery instructions.

timeline.text:
Back aboard the Falcon, Han transmitted the recovered records to Leia through an encrypted Alliance channel.

He waited while the connection established.

Her hologram appeared above the console.

timeline.tts: Well, the cantina's still standing. Found your secret station. Found some recordings. Nearly got killed by a security droid.
timeline.text: Well, the cantina's still standing. Found your secret station. Found some recordings. Nearly got killed by a security droid.

timeline.tts: Hahn leaned forward.
timeline.text: Han leaned forward.

timeline.tts: Listen, sweetheart. We found something about Darren. Someone sent an activation command from this station to Kor-uh-sant on the morning he jumped. That's the interesting part. The authorization belonged to Sim Ah-loo.
timeline.text: Listen, sweetheart. We found something about Darren. Someone sent an activation command from this station to Coruscant on the morning he jumped. That's the interesting part. The authorization belonged to Sim Aloo.

timeline.tts: He smiled.

timeline.text:
Back aboard the Falcon, Han transmitted the recovered records to Leia through an encrypted Alliance channel.

He waited while the connection established.

Her hologram appeared above the console.

timeline.tts: How did it go? That's encouraging. Are you hurt?
timeline.text: How did it go? That's encouraging. Are you hurt?

timeline.tts: Her expression changed immediately.
timeline.text: Her expression changed immediately.

timeline.tts: One of the Emperor's advisers? But he died aboard the second Death Star. Can you identify who's receiving them?
timeline.text: One of the Emperor's advisers? But he died aboard the second Death Star. Can you identify who's receiving them?

timeline.tts: She looked up.
timeline.text: She looked up.

timeline.tts: Hahn, I want you to bring those files back. We can send a proper intelligence team later. Those records may explain what happened to Darren. Thank you. Come home, Hahn.
timeline.text: Han, I want you to bring those files back. We can send a proper intelligence team later. Those records may explain what happened to Darren. Thank you. Come home, Han.

voices.text:
Narrator: Back aboard the Falcon, Han transmitted the recovered records to Leia through an encrypted Alliance channel.

He waited while the connection established.

Her hologram appeared above the console.

Leia: How did it go? That's encouraging. Are you hurt?

Narrator: Her expression changed immediately.

Leia: One of the Emperor's advisers? But he died aboard the second Death Star. Can you identify who's receiving them?

Narrator: She looked up.

Leia: Han, I want you to bring those files back. We can send a proper intelligence team later. Those records may explain what happened to Darren. Thank you. Come home, Han.
